title: add-transactional-downgrade-guard-backup-restore-version-pinning-private-installer
author: Claire Zhang
description:
Motivation: private deployments have caused multiple customer incidents when partial schema migrations and version skew combined with an interrupted upgrade left clusters in an unrecoverable state. This PR introduces a coordinated, transactional upgrade/rollback guard for the private-installer path that ties together version pinning, atomic backup/restore checkpoints, and a lightweight transactional schema migration wrapper.

Summary of changes: implement a transactional migration coordinator that: 1) verifies version pin compatibility before applying migrations; 2) takes an online logical backup checkpoint (Postgres pg_dump/consistent snapshot) and uploads to the configured artifact store; 3) runs schema migrations within a guarded transaction window and records migration metadata to the installer state; 4) exposes a downgrade_guard flag that prevents rollbacks unless a verified restore artifact is present and migration metadata is compatible.

What I changed (high-level): updated private-installer binary and helm chart hooks to call the migration coordinator; added terraform module hooks to ensure the artifact store (S3/minio) and KMS keys are provisioned for backups; added a migration metadata table and transactional wrapper around migration steps; added CLI surface for manual checkpoint/restore; added e2e/integration tests to exercise interrupted upgrade + rollback scenarios.

Rollback/Recovery: rollbacks are only permitted when a matching restore artifact exists and the migration metadata indicates safe rollback (no destructive irreversible migrations applied). If a rollback is attempted without a verified checkpoint, the installer will surface a clear error and refuse the downgrade; operators can use the new 'installer restore --from-checkpoint <id>' flow to recover.

Compatibility and version pinning: component images and helm charts are version-pinned during the upgrade flow to avoid implicit drifting. The coordinator will refuse to proceed when detected image versions are not in the approved compatibility matrix. This matrix is surfaced in docs/upgrade-compatibility.md and generated as part of the release pipeline.

Testing: unit tests for migration coordinator logic, integration tests against a Postgres test harness with simulated interruption, and a full private-installer canary run in our perf-canary environment. CI flakiness was observed on the first e2e run (timeout during large dump) and was addressed by streaming the dump to S3 and adding retries.

Rollout plan: ship behind a feature flag in private-installer; enable for a small set of internal customers for 2 weeks, run smoke upgrade + rollback playbook, gather metrics. After validation flip the default flag on for new installations and offer a migration tool for existing clusters.

Related: references ENG-9473 (migration reliability initiative) and ENG-9510 (private installer hardening). See docs/upgrade-compatibility.md and docs/installer/rollback-playbook.md for operator steps.
